pages.title: Cipher Loom
pages.text: A loom whose warp is data and whose weft is parity: every thread checks its neighbours.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the block length n and the parity bits r. A Hamming code with r parity bits covers blocks of up to 2^r − 1 bits and corrects one flipped bit in each; a block fails if two flip, about (nε)²/2 of the time, which must be under the tolerance. Longer blocks carry more data per bit.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Error-Correcting Code, One-Time Pad.
